ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (13) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Заблуждение» (zabluzhdenie, 'error') is kept as 'error' throughout the Schopenhauer passages, and «ложь» (lozh') as 'falsehood' or 'lie'; the website's 'delusion' is not used. «Благо» (blago) is 'the good'.
